claim_boundary: The implementation is exact only for its deterministic charged order when cut width and all explicit capabilities are bounded. It does not solve the NAND3 hard image, prove universal low width, or resolve P versus NP.
constructive_theorem: For the charged deterministic parallel-block order, if every cut B_t=span(prefix normals) intersect span(suffix normals) has fixed dimension k, exact SAT/UNSAT compilation and independent verification use 2^O(k) poly(L) total work and certificate volume.
exact_object: Proof-carrying affine-functional trellis over cut normal-space intersections with distinguished offset functionals
offset_rule: Each factor retains beta_i:N_i->GF(2); a leaf transition is admitted only when the local functional differs from beta_i on at least one normal-basis row.
